players.min.label: Fewest players
players.min.help: The smallest player count a new run allows.

players.max.label: Most players
players.max.help: The largest player count a new run allows.

player.maxHealth.label: Maximum health
player.maxHealth.help: Each player starts with this health and cannot heal above it.

player.startingDice.label: Starting dice
player.startingDice.help: Action dice each player has at level 1.

player.starterSkills.label: Starter Skills
player.starterSkills.help: The Skills on each player board at the start. Tick at least 1.

player.draftSlots.label: Draft Skill slots
player.draftSlots.help: The most drafted Skills a player can hold, on top of the starter Skills.

deck.preset.label: Deck and hand preset
deck.preset.help: The preset below that new runs use.

deck.presets.label: Deck and hand presets
deck.presets.help: Each preset has an id, a hand size, and its starter cards with a quantity each. Cards are picked from the card list, so a preset can only name cards that exist.

deck.minimumSize.label: Smallest deck
deck.minimumSize.help: A player never has fewer cards than this. A starter card is returned only while the player has more.

base.startingHealth.label: Starting base health
base.startingHealth.help: The base health at the start of a run. The run stops when it reaches 0.

base.healthPerUpgrade.label: Health per upgrade
base.healthPerUpgrade.help: Each base upgrade adds this much to the maximum base health and to the base health.

combat.maxRolls.label: Rolls per exchange
combat.maxRolls.help: The most times a player rolls dice in one combat exchange.

combat.exchangeRange.label: Exchange range
combat.exchangeRange.help: If no enemy is within this many hexes, the exchange has no effect and the hand is discarded.

combat.enemyMoveHexes.label: Enemy move
combat.enemyMoveHexes.help: Hexes each enemy moves toward its target at the start of Combat.

combat.moveCostNextToEnemy.label: Move cost next to an enemy
combat.moveCostNextToEnemy.help: Hexes a Move pays to enter a hex next to an enemy. 1 (default): no extra cost. 2: the written rule (6.9).

combat.enemyAttacks.label: Enemy attacks per Combat
combat.enemyAttacks.help: Row 65: how often an enemy attacks in one Combat. Off: the current rule (every exchange). Once per Combat: an enemy that has attacked is tipped over and does not attack again until the next Combat starts.

combat.adjacentAttack.label: Which adjacent enemies attack
combat.adjacentAttack.help: Row 69: at the end of a player's exchange, which enemies next to the figure attack it. Off: the current rule (only enemies that target that player).

options.target-only: Only enemies that target the player (off)

combat.model.label: Combat model
combat.model.help: Engagements (default): play Engage to roll from where you stand; each enemy next to you rolls a die back, and enemies hit structures at the end of Combat. Exchanges: the Combat in the written rules. In each exchange you roll, play cards, and fire Skills; then every enemy next to you attacks.

combat.engage.enemyDie.label: Enemy die faces
combat.engage.enemyDie.help: The 6 faces of an enemy die: hit, miss, or special.

combat.engage.hitDamage.label: Hit damage
combat.engage.hitDamage.help: Damage a Hit face deals to you (guard first).

combat.engage.specialDamage.label: Special damage
combat.engage.specialDamage.help: Damage a Special face deals, until each grunt type has its own Special.

combat.engage.eliteDice.label: Elite enemy dice
combat.engage.eliteDice.help: Enemy dice an elite rolls when you engage it or stand next to it.

combat.engage.siegeDamage.label: Siege damage
combat.engage.siegeDamage.help: At the end of Combat, each grunt next to a structure deals this much to it.

combat.engage.eliteSiegeDamage.label: Elite siege damage
combat.engage.eliteSiegeDamage.help: Siege damage of an elite, until elites have their own siege rule.

combat.engage.defeatedDice.label: Defeated enemies' dice
combat.engage.defeatedDice.help: Hit: every enemy die rolled hits at the end of the engagement, all at once, even the dice of an enemy you defeated (default). Cancelled: a defeated enemy's dice do not hit (experiment).

experience.stepIncrease.label: Step increase
experience.stepIncrease.help: Each next level needs this much more experience than the step before it.

experience.eliteBonus.label: Extra experience for an elite
experience.eliteBonus.help: Row 17: experience added when an elite is defeated, on top of its normal experience. Off: the current rule (0).

experience.levelPerEliteSpawn.label: 1 level for each elite that spawns
experience.levelPerEliteSpawn.help: Row 17: when ticked, the level rises by 1 each time an elite spawns (also when the miniature limit turns a grunt into an elite), and experience no longer raises the level. Off: the current rule.

miniatureLimit.label: Enemy miniature limit
miniatureLimit.help: The most enemies on the map. Past the limit, a new grunt or elite turns the grunt nearest the base into an elite instead.

clock.forcedRevealEvery.label: Forced reveal every
clock.forcedRevealEvery.help: Row 63: at round end, if no tile was revealed in this many rounds, the top tile of the tile deck is revealed in the open slot nearest the base. Off: the current rule.

spawn.rampEvery.label: Spawn ramp every
spawn.rampEvery.help: Row 64: each spawn node spawns 1 more enemy every this many rounds (1 + (round - 1) / N, rounded down). Off: the current rule.

spawn.newTileDelay.label: New tile waits
spawn.newTileDelay.help: Row 66: rounds a newly revealed tile waits before its spawn nodes spawn. 1: new tiles wait one round. Off: the current rule (0).

spawn.perSeat.label: Spawns scale with seats
spawn.perSeat.help: Row 68: when ticked, each spawn node spawns 1 enemy per 2 seats, rounded up (1 for 1-2 seats, 2 for 3-4). Off: the current rule.

spawn.nodeRange.label: Spawn range
spawn.nodeRange.help: Row 70: only spawn nodes within this many hexes of a player figure, a Barricade, a Tower, or the base spawn. Off: the current rule.

gather.offNodeAmount.label: Gather off a node
gather.offNodeAmount.help: Row 67: materials a Gather gives on a spent node or off any node. Nodes stay single-use. Off: the current rule (0).

knockout.returnHealthDivisor.label: Return health divisor
knockout.returnHealthDivisor.help: A knocked-out player returns at the next round start with maximum health divided by this, rounded up.

knockout.loseMaterials.label: Knockout loses materials
knockout.loseMaterials.help: When on, a knocked-out player loses the materials they carried.

shop.offers.label: Shop offers
shop.offers.help: Cards the open Shop shows at a time.

draft.reveal.label: Skills revealed
draft.reveal.help: Skills each player looks at in a draft.

draft.keep.label: Skills kept
draft.keep.help: Skills each player keeps from a draft.

draft.everyNRounds.label: Draft every N rounds
draft.everyNRounds.help: With the Training Ground open, a draft happens in each round that this number divides.

draft.unpicked.label: Skills you do not keep
draft.unpicked.help: Pool (default): they go to your own pool, and each later draft offers the new Skills plus your whole pool, so the choice grows and is not tied to one training level. Supply: they go to the bottom of their supply (the written rule).

supplies.copiesPerCard.label: Copies of each card
supplies.copiesPerCard.help: Copies of each card in the card supplies.

supplies.copiesPerSkill.label: Copies of each Skill
supplies.copiesPerSkill.help: Copies of each Skill in the Skill supplies.

tiles.revealMoveCost.label: Movement to reveal a tile
tiles.revealMoveCost.help: Movement a step off the map edge costs. The step reveals the top tile of the tile deck under the hex entered.

milestones.surviveRounds.label: Survive to rounds
milestones.surviveRounds.help: Round numbers that each give a milestone, separated by commas.

milestones.upgradesBought.label: Base upgrades bought
milestones.upgradesBought.help: Base upgrades the players must buy for this milestone.

milestones.tilesRevealed.label: Tiles revealed
milestones.tilesRevealed.help: Tiles the players must reveal for this milestone.

milestones.level.label: Level reached
milestones.level.help: The level the players must reach for this milestone.

milestones.skillFired.label: Skill fired
milestones.skillFired.help: The Skill a player must fire for this milestone.

options.boughtCards.label: Bought cards
options.boughtCards.help: What a card bought in the Shop does to the deck.

options.maxLevel.label: Maximum level
options.maxLevel.help: The highest level the players can reach. Off: no maximum.

options.skillUses.label: Skill uses
options.skillUses.help: How often each Skill can fire in one exchange or engagement. Default: unlimited, as long as the dice fill it again.

rulings.enemiesPerHex.label: Enemies per hex
rulings.enemiesPerHex.help: The most enemies one hex can hold.

rulings.figuresPerHex.label: Figures per hex
rulings.figuresPerHex.help: The most player figures one hex can hold.

rulings.blockedPathRule.label: Blocked enemy
rulings.blockedPathRule.help: What an enemy does when every path to its nearest target is blocked.

options.next-target: Move toward the next nearest target

rulings.tileRotation.label: Tile rotation
rulings.tileRotation.help: When ticked, the player may rotate a revealed tile.

rulings.coopPrepareOrder.label: Co-op Prepare order
rulings.coopPrepareOrder.help: How 2 to 4 players take turns in the Prepare phase.

options.full-turn: Each player plays a whole deck in turn

rulings.structureDamage.label: Structure damage
rulings.structureDamage.help: How enemies damage Barricades, Towers, and the base in the structure attack step.

options.v1: As an attack on a player (grunt 2, elite 6 dice)

rulings.skirmishFail.label: Lost skirmish
rulings.skirmishFail.help: What happens to the Move when a skirmish does not clear the hex.

options.stay-lose-move: Stay; the rest of the Move is lost
options.stay-keep-move: Stay; keep the rest of the Move

rulings.fullBoardDraft.label: Draft with full slots
rulings.fullBoardDraft.help: What a draft does when every draft Skill slot is full.

options.swap: The kept Skill replaces a drafted Skill

rulings.mandatoryPlays.label: Every card must be played
rulings.mandatoryPlays.help: When ticked, a card cannot be discarded without its effect.

rulings.shopTiming.label: Shop timing
rulings.shopTiming.help: When a player on the base may buy cards.

options.any-time-on-base: At any time on the base

rulings.shopRefill.label: Shop refill
rulings.shopRefill.help: When a bought Shop offer is replaced.

options.end-of-turn: At the end of the turn

rulings.healTargets.label: Heal targets
rulings.healTargets.help: Who a heal effect can heal in co-op.

options.any-adjacent: The player or an adjacent ally

rulings.eliteReplacement.label: Grunt that becomes an elite
rulings.eliteReplacement.help: Which grunt the miniature limit turns into an elite.

rulings.buildOnNode.label: Defenses on gathering nodes
rulings.buildOnNode.help: When ticked, a defense may stand on a gathering node hex, and the node still works.

rulings.gatherNeedsNode.label: Gather needs a node
rulings.gatherNeedsNode.help: When ticked, Gather gives materials only on an unspent gathering node, and spends it. When not ticked, Gather also works off a node.

rulings.targetTieBreak.label: Enemy target order
rulings.targetTieBreak.help: Which equally near target an enemy picks first, top to bottom.

rulings.playerPullDistance.label: Player pull distance
rulings.playerPullDistance.help: Enemies head for the nearest structure; they turn to a player only when the player is at least this many hexes nearer. 0 ranks players by distance alone.
